mechanism_fidelity.rationale: Repeatable failure testing, removal of configuration parts, retention of failing reductions, and test-relative minimization preserve the source chain. Dependency-valid reductions constrain the search, while the stated limits prevent claims of global minimality or unique causal attribution.

target_fidelity.rationale: Identifying a dependency set sufficient to reproduce publication failure under the test provides an explicitly bounded contribution to the dependency question and a basis for a remedy test. It does not establish a unique cause or an effective remedy.

operational_coherence.rationale: The stipulated isolated pipeline and fixed seed make repeated reduction tests intelligible. Their outcomes support identifying a failure-preserving set minimal relative to permitted, resolved tests, with unresolved outcomes and search limitations explicitly qualifying that inference.

validity.rationale: The mapping preserves delta debugging and supports a bounded contribution to the retained target question without claiming unique causation or a validated remedy.

uncertainty: No reduction results identify the actual retained dependency set or establish remedy effectiveness.
Results under the fixed seed and isolated environment do not establish coverage of intermittent failures under other seeds or environments.
